title: Canonical termwise coinduction Hom comparison
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a Koszul chart T of [def-trf-lci-koszul-duality-data] and exactness proof data h of [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data], define the termwise coinduction followed by scalar restriction functor on cochain complexes. Define its canonical natural isomorphism with the Hom complex of [def-pur-hom-complex] from the quotient module in degree zero. For every coefficient complex I and degree n, its inverse component is the source-degree-zero projection homComplexπ followed by the inverse ordinary evaluation-normalized comparison of [def-trf-lci-coinduction-ordinary-hom] applied to I.X n. Include existence with this exact determining formula; the formula fixes every component and hence the isomorphism.
